description: NaCa₃ScZn₃(SiO₃)₈ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.82 Å. There are three inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.84 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.78 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.83 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.23 Å. There are three inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.21 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.20 Å. In the third Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.20 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three ZnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ octahedra, corners with two ZnO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-58°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.70 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ octahedra, corners with two ZnO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.69 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ octahedra, corners with two ZnO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.70 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Ca, two Zn, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCaZn₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Sc, one Zn, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Ca, two Zn, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCaZn₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Sc, one Zn, and one Si atom.
